actions.name: amphibious
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three  [[/item .mmRend0000000000]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast [[/item .mmSpellcasting00.Activity.hHQiQYfo3AV5ZW6F]] (level 5 version).

actions.name: poison breath
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=lnabW9bM51HoluPp]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=lnabW9bM51HoluPp]]-foot [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=lnabW9bM51HoluPp]]. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMindSpike0]{Mind Spike} (level 5 version) 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGeas000000]{Geas}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplModifyMemo]{Modify Memory}

actions.name: mind invasion
actions.desc: The dragon uses [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast [[/item .mmSpellcasting00.Activity.hHQiQYfo3AV5ZW6F]] (level 3 version).

actions.name: noxious miasma
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=Blm8nddvCOH69bL8]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=Blm8nddvCOH69bL8]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=Blm8nddvCOH69bL8]]-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=Blm8nddvCOH69bL8]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target takes a −2 penalty to AC until the end of its next turn. Failure or Success: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: pounce
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item Rend]] attack.
